thread:
marta_ops: Heads-up: this morning's privatelink NAT policy tightened and our scheduled keystore rotation overlapped. seeing a cluster of GPU pool onboarding failures in us-west-1 and uus2. warmups failing ~35% on cold starts.

dev_li: Yep — kubelet logs show repeated 'tls handshake reset' and the keystore client logs show 'session dropped after SYN_RECV' during decrypt.

sre_tom: I traced to conntrack exhaustion on the NAT boxes servicing privatelink endpoints. bursts from rotation + warmup spikes evaporated state.

sec_harper: That policy was pushed to reduce lateral blast radius; we didn't expect rotation to generate N->privatelink fanout. That said, we need a safe immediate path.

marta_ops: Proposed immediate runbook: 1) create short-lived allow rule for svc:gpu-warmup -> privatelink CIDs (30m TTL) created via TF with annotation referencing rotation ticket, 2) bump NAT conntrack min on privatelink fleet, 3) enable client-side TLS keepalive to reduce half-open states.

dev_li: I'll prepare the TF snippet. snippet:```hcl
resource "fw_rule" "tmp_warmup_allow_1766667777" {
  name      = "tmp-warmup-allow-1766667777"
  src_tag   = "svc:gpu-warmup"
  dst_cidrs = ["10.200.0.0/24","10.200.1.0/24"]
  ttl_min   = 30
  meta      = { request = "keystore-rotation-1766667777" }
}
```
I'll push to canary in 5m.

sre_tom: In parallel I'll open a small change to ip_conntrack_max on privatelink NATs: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288` then restart monitoring agents. expected cost: small infra delta.

sec_harper: Approve TTL 30m with audit log. please ensure ticket link is present and rotate runbook gets updated to include a pre-rotation check for conntrack headroom.

deploybot: canary TF apply queued (us-west-2-canary), will report status.

finance_rachel: quick estimate: increasing conntrack and adding an extra NAT pool will be ~+$2.4k/mo. If this becomes standard we should include in next monthly forecast.

dev_li: Workaround also added to warmup pod: client keeps TLS keepalive and exponential retry. patch: `kubectl set env daemonset/gpu-warmup KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL=15 KEEPALIVE_PROBES=3`. Canary shows reduced half-open connections.

sre_tom: Canary nodes improved to 93% warmup success after the keepalive env and TF allow. rolling to region.

marta_ops: Medium-term agenda: (A) stagger keystore rotations by AZ/region so we don't create global handshake storms, (B) add release gate that simulates keystore rotation + privatelink saturation, (C) consider regional keystore caches to reduce cross-region decrypt traffic.

sec_harper: On (C) we need a compliance review before caching keys regionally; I'll draft criteria for HSM-backed regional caches.

finance_rachel: also note tagging: any short-lived allow must include billing tag so we can track cost of mitigations.

dev_li: monitoring tasks: create alert `gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.85 for 5m`, `privatelink_conntrack_util > 0.9`, and `keystore_decrypt_errors > 5/min`. add metric `warmup_keystore_handshake_retries`.

marta_ops: Allow applied and canary healthy. I'll post the incident summary and create a follow-up to stagger rotations. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
